Source: An axe opens the windfall logs. Keep it equipped when you chop.

ko-kr: 도끼가 있으면 쓰러진 통나무를 벨 수 있어요. 벨 때는 손에 들고 있으세요.

Source: Put any material into a camp project.

en-us: Your development has earned more land. Apply the new boundary at your dock.
ko-kr: 개발 실적 덕분에 땅을 더 받을 수 있어요. 부두에서 새 경계를 적용하세요.

en-us: The boundary is expanded. Existing buildings and permissions remain yours.
ko-kr: 경계가 넓어졌어요. 기존 건물과 권한은 그대로 당신 것이에요.

Source: Mash and cook these berries, then eat the meal.
en-us: Mash and cook these berries, then eat the meal.
ko-kr: 이 열매를 으깨서 요리한 다음, 그 음식을 드세요.

en-us: List this fiber for one Coin, cancel the listing, and collect it from returns.

ko-kr: 이 열매를 훈련용 냉장고에 넣고 상하는 속도를 확인한 다음, 다시 꺼내세요.

en-us: Try these loaned volcanic boots, inspect the exposure reduction, then return them.

en-us: Boots reduce exposure; refuges stop it. Neither makes lava safe.

en-us: The relay is repeating a pattern. Read the inland signal, assemble a lens, and test it here.

en-us: That pattern is a distress call, not weather noise. We have a direction to follow.

Source: Your station can now keep the journal connected. Technical support still waits until level sixty.
en-us: Your station can now keep the journal connected. Technical support still waits until level sixty.
ko-kr: 이제 기지가 일지를 계속 연결해 줄 거예요. 기술 지원은 여전히 레벨 60을 기다려야 해요.

Source: Bring readings from the first and fourth grassland stages, with three samples in a case.
en-us: Bring readings from the first and fourth grassland stages, with three samples in a case.

en-us: The samples carry the same trace. The signal crossed the whole route, not just one island.

en-us: Read the marsh markers, make onion soup, and take this remedy to the refuge.
ko-kr: 습지 표식을 읽고 양파 수프를 끓인 다음, 이 치료제를 대피소로 가져가세요.

en-us: The explorer is stable. The soup was food; the supplied remedy was treatment. Do not confuse either with immunity.

en-us: Survey the desert marker and the neutral outpost, then contribute a research bundle to the public ledger.
